prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1077; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is now pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any other party is represented by counsel, please forward this notice accordingly.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury liability limits applicable to this claim, along with confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, repair estimates, and any vehicle or electronic data in your possession or under your control. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained pending resolution of this claim.
